summary: Iter54 focused on E19 money/voucher end-to-end. Backend HTTP suite test_iter54_e19_e2e.py: 9/9 passed on public URL — /health & /payments/config (mock), voucher validate, guest checkout with idempotency key, PARALLEL 5x POST /orders/{code}/pay returning SAME gateway_order_id (single attempt), customer login checkout with admin cancel restoring stock, admin CANNOT cancel paid order (400) and partial refund records exactly once, /api/cron/reconcile & /api/cron/expire-orders ack 202 and same X-Webhook-Id -> duplicate ack, cron 401 without secret. Frontend E2E via public URL: customer login (/akun) -> shop -> PDP -> add-to-cart -> /checkout, address dialog filled, voucher WELCOME10 applied (checkout-voucher-applied badge visible). BUTIR 18 VOUCHER RECHECK VERIFIED: page.route('**/api/vouchers/validate', abort) then changing shipping option triggered `checkout-voucher-unverified` banner AND `checkout-voucher-recheck` button; pressing `checkout-place-order-button` produced toast 'Diskon voucher belum terverifikasi — Tekan Validasi ulang sebelum membuat pesanan' and order was NOT created. Unrouted + clicked recheck -> unverified cleared -> place order succeeded, redirected to /pesanan-sukses?code=CP00000159 with Midtrans mock simulation modal visible. CartSync verified: PUT /api/cart from session A persisted and GET /api/cart from fresh session B returned identical items for same customer. Storefront regression: /shop (12 products), /lokasi, /kontak load fine. Admin login via /akun with admin creds works (Admin Collector badge), /admin/pesanan lists paginated orders (26 rows shown, new orders visible with correct statuses Menunggu/Dibayar/Dibatalkan), /admin/konten Visual Builder loads.
critical_code_review_comments: services/gateway.py start_payment uses pay_locks (unique on order_code) + subsequent poll loop for concurrent callers — correctly returns single gateway_order_id under parallel POST /pay (verified with 5x async). Lock TTL 30s and 25*0.2s polling loop is well matched.

services/order_create.py: reserving->pending CAS + abort_reservation on any failure, plus sweep_stale_reserving (2min cutoff) via reconcile cron — well tested by parametrized crash-at-every-write in existing test_ledger_e19.py; HTTP-level tests confirm real endpoint behavior.

hooks/useCheckoutVoucher.js validates voucher on every cart.subtotal/shipPrice/selectedShipping change and only sets voucherCheck='ok' after successful re-validate. Butir 18 correctly gates place-order via `voucherUnverified` flag; toast description guides user to recheck. Solid.
routers/cron.py: correct Authorization+HMAC compare, insert cron_runs with unique run_id, _reclaim CAS for failed/stale runs, ack 202 always. Duplicate run_id returns {duplicate: true}, verified.
routers/admin_orders.py: _with_allowed computes allowed_transitions server-side (SALES-18) — good source of truth; paid orders exclude 'cancelled' correctly so /status returns 400.

Leftover seed shipping method 'Uji' (id t-ship) from earlier ledger-e19 unit tests is still present in shipping_methods collection (shows up as an option on /checkout). Non-blocking but cluttering. Consider adding a teardown in test_ledger_e19._fixtures or a dedicated cleanup pass in scripts/qa_cleanup.py to remove {'id': 't-ship'} and {'id': 't-pay'}.
